data.body: Task 172 addition 2026-10-04: second reference plugin "FFmpeg media tools" at desktop/tool-plugins/ffmpeg (plugin.ffmpeg). Real stdio MCP bridge ffmpeg_bridge.py with 8 tools (ffmpeg_doctor/probe read-only, convert, trim copy|encode, extract_audio, thumbnail, gif palette two-pass, run destructive). Targets FFmpeg 9.0.x "Lei" (9.0.2, 2026-09-18, current per ffmpeg.org) and works from 6.1. Structured tools protect the input, refuse existing outputs unless overwrite, bound timeouts, resolve relative paths against --workdir, and return a fresh ffprobe validation block. Skill at skills/ffmpeg/SKILL.md. Verified: python3 test_ffmpeg_bridge.py ran real ffmpeg 6.1.1 E2E (all passed), Rust tool_registry 11/11, tsc clean, vitest 12/12.
